description: Model Eligibility must match across the assist letter/STC, the application letter, and the PMA supplement.
findingText: The Model Eligibility does not match across all three documents (assist letter or STC, application letter, and PMA supplement).
resolutionHint: Reconcile Model Eligibility. Use 'B' before Boeing models and 'A' before Airbus models; use the word 'Series' or 'Models' as the assist letter or STC does; add special notes or exceptions as applicable.
limitations: Cannot verify the eligibility itself against the TCDS; it checks agreement between the three documents only.
citationNote: Cites the form/procedure by role; the tenant profile supplies its own controlled document number and revision when the finding is rendered.
